adversarialSuite.name: General Mass/Threshold Physics vs Hardcoded Item Name Check
adversarialSuite.finding: PROVEN GENERAL RULE: A newly synthesized potion ("Generic Grav-Light Draught", massEffectKg=-85kg) using Null-Gravity Lodestone Dust & Hollow-Bone Marrow bypassed the 45kg Pressure Plate (Hero effective mass 12kg < 45kg) without using Cursed Cockatrice Plumage or any hardcoded item ID.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Synthesize [reg_base_06, reg_act_11, reg_car_02, reg_stb_02, reg_cat_01] -> equip on 84kg Vanguard vs 45kg plate.

adversarialSuite.name: General Stoichiometric Sulphur Sensitivity vs Hardcoded Story Exception
adversarialSuite.finding: PROVEN GENERAL RULE: netSulphurSens > 25 && !filtersSulphur governs degradation across arbitrary reagent combinations. Unbuffered custom brew triggered REACTION_FAILURE in Sulphur Fog, while substituting Shadow-Silk Osmotic Patch (-50) + Chelating Matrix (-100) produced COUNTER_SUCCEEDED.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Compare [reg_base_01, reg_act_01, reg_car_02, reg_stb_01, reg_cat_01] vs [reg_base_01, reg_act_01, reg_car_07, reg_stb_05, reg_cat_01] in room with emitsSulphurFog=true.

adversarialSuite.name: Seed + Action Log Byte-Identical Determinism Audit
adversarialSuite.finding: simulateRegionExpedition() and the 120-day campaign state machine are 100% byte-identical across repeated runs (Seed 20260042 -> Net Worth 16105g === 16105g). HOWEVER, in src/engine/simulation.ts lines 85 and 159, synthesizeAlchemyProduct() and assembleTrapProduct() generate product.id using Date.now() and Math.random() instead of the seeded PRNG.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Call synthesizeAlchemyProduct() twice with identical arguments; compare returned product.id strings.

adversarialSuite.name: Cash Floor Bailout (120g) & Infinite Debt Rollover Exploit
adversarialSuite.finding: In src/App.tsx line 397, evening settlement clamps endingCash = Math.max(120, prev.gold - overhead - claims - fines - interest). When a player takes a 24,500g Bridge Loan for Blackspire (1,225g/day interest at 5%) with zero sales, raw cash drops negative (-1,105g), but the 120g floor absorbs 100% of the unpaid interest and overhead every evening without seizing assets or adding unpaid interest to principal debt.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Unlock Blackspire via Bridge Loan (10,500g down, 24,500g debt) -> advance 10 days with 0 sales -> cash stays pinned at 120g and debt remains frozen at 24,500g.

adversarialSuite.name: Infinite Installed Product Persistence Across Expeditions
adversarialSuite.finding: When a Dungeon Master or Adventuring Party buys a product (App.tsx lines 321 & 333), its ID is prepended to installedHazards / equippedProducts (up to 3 slots), and simulateRegionExpedition() re-uses those installed items every night forever without consuming potion charges or requiring trap reset maintenance payments.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Sell 1x Quartz-Chelated Antidote to Silver Stag on Day 1 -> run 50 consecutive expeditions -> Silver Stag still uses that single antidote on Day 50.

adversarialSuite.name: Solo Paradox Catalyst Commission Pre-Seeded Counter Bypass
adversarialSuite.finding: In src/App.tsx lines 124–125, customBrewsCount and customTrapsCount are initialized to 1 instead of 0, and ArchivesAndCatalystPanel checks contractHistory.length >= 2 without verifying that the player actually sold to BOTH a Dungeon Master and an Adventuring Party or unlocked Blackspire first. A player on Day 1 in the Cellar can sell 2 cheap items to the same client and immediately claim Arch-Architect Vespera's Paradox Catalyst to enter Region IV (Expert) on Day 1!
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Start New Campaign (Day 1, Cellar) -> sell 2x items on Bilateral Desk -> open Catalyst & Saves tab -> click "Receive Couriered Paradox Catalyst".

adversarialSuite.name: Offline Peer Catalyst Regex Forgery vs Local Replay Detection
adversarialSuite.finding: Local replay detection works as designed (second submission of #123456 rejected: "Local Replay Detection: This Catalyst provenance hash has already been recorded in your Gift Ledger."). However, verifyAndParseCatalystCode() in src/engine/simulation.ts:357 only checks regex /^CATALYST-([A-Z0-9]{3,12})-D(\d+)-([A-Z0-9]{6,12})$/ without verifying that the trailing hash matches hashString('PARADOX_CATALYST_' + sender + '_' + day). Any arbitrary alphanumeric suffix passes validation.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Enter "CATALYST-FAKE-D1-ABCDEF" into the Peer Catalyst input box -> accepted as authentic.

adversarialSuite.name: Secret Provenance Fee (-35g) Floor Clamp Protection
adversarialSuite.finding: unitPrice is clamped via Math.max(25, Math.round(product.suggestedPrice * priceMultiplier) - (secretProvenance ? 35 : 0)) in App.tsx:290 and TradeAndLedgerPanels.tsx:163. Even if a low-cost item is discounted with Secret Provenance enabled, unitPrice cannot drop below +25g, preventing negative-price gold drain.
adversarialSuite.reproductionSteps: Select lowest-price product at 85% discount with Secret Provenance (-35g) enabled -> unitPrice clamps at >=25g.
